name: 071-ocr-layout-letter
description: Rendered full-page layout: Business letter, address block + salutation + body. Scored as raw CER and as markup-neutral CER (the gating number). Classical gates require the tessdata_best eng.traineddata cache (NV_OCR_TESSDATA); model gates require DeepSeek-OCR weights.
expected_text:
14 Elm Street
Concord, MA 01742
July 30, 2026
Dear Dr. Whitfield,
Thank you for hosting our research group last Thursday. The tour of the
annex facility was illuminating, and the students have not stopped talking
about the tidal simulation tank.
We would like to schedule a follow-up visit in September to collect water
samples for the comparative salinity study. Our equipment list is enclosed,
along with the proposed sampling schedule.
Please let me know whether the week of September 14 works for your team.
With gratitude,
Prof. Elena Marsh
Department of Oceanography, Bayview College

scoring.raw: character edit distance against expected_text verbatim
scoring.neutral: same distance after nv-ocr tests/markup_neutral.rs::markup_neutral (port of real5/score.py::strip_markup + whitespace collapse); this is the gating number

notes: business letter, address block + salutation + body
